title: Discovery and optimization of 1H-pyrazolo[3,4-d]pyrimidine-3-carboxamide derivatives as USP1 inhibitors for BRCA1-mutant cancer treatment.
authors: Zhao, Tuotuo; Chen, Congwei; An, Yuxiang; Xu, Yuting; Guo, Yong; Yao, Shanyan; Zhou, Baobao; Chen, Yi; Duan, Wenhu; Guan, Zhiyu; Tang, Wei; Zhang, Hefeng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究USP1小分子抑制剂的设计与优化，针对BRCA1突变癌症治疗，虽含分子对接与动力学，但对象为蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Ubiquitin-specific protease 1 (USP1) plays a critical role in deubiquitinating key protein complexes involved in the DNA damage response (DDR). Inhibition of USP1 has been shown to induce synthetic lethality in BRCA1-mutant cancers, making it an attractive anticancer therapeutic target. In this study, a series of 1H-pyrazolo[3,4-d]pyrimidine-3-carboxamide derivatives were designed and synthesized as novel inhibitors of USP1. The resulting compounds exhibited nanomolar-level inhibitory activity against USP1 and potently inhibited the proliferation of the BRCA1-mutant MDA-MB-436 cells. Among them, compound 18 exhibited an IC(50) value of 8.1 nM against MDA-MB-436 and demonstrated superior selectivity for BRCA1-mutant cells over BRCA1-wild-type cells. Western blot analysis revealed that compound 18 significantly increased DNA damage accumulation of BRCA1-mutant cells. In vivo pharmacokinetic studies were conducted to determine the oral exposure of compound 18. Moreover, molecular docking and dynamics studies were performed to elucidate the detailed binding mechanism of compound 18 with USP1. Taken together, this study presents a promising class of 1H-pyrazolo[3,4-d]pyrimidine-3-carboxamide derivatives as novel USP1 inhibitors with significant therapeutic potential for the treatment of BRCA1-mutant cancers.
abstract_zh: 泛素特异性蛋白酶1（USP1）在去泛素化参与DNA损伤应答（DDR）的关键蛋白复合物中发挥关键作用。研究表明，抑制USP1可在BRCA1突变型癌症中诱导合成致死性，使其成为有吸引力的抗癌治疗靶点。本研究设计并合成了一系列1H-吡唑并[3,4-d]嘧啶-3-甲酰胺衍生物作为新型USP1抑制剂。所得化合物对USP1表现出纳摩尔级抑制活性，并有效抑制BRCA1突变型MDA-MB-436细胞的增殖。其中，化合物18对MDA-MB-436的IC(50)值为8.1 nM，并显示出对BRCA1突变型细胞优于BRCA1野生型细胞的选择性。Western blot分析显示，化合物18显著增加了BRCA1突变型细胞的DNA损伤积累。进行了体内药代动力学研究以确定化合物18的口服暴露量。此外，进行了分子对接和动力学研究以阐明化合物18与USP1的详细结合机制。综上所述，本研究提出了一类有前景的1H-吡唑并[3,4-d]嘧啶-3-甲酰胺衍生物作为新型USP1抑制剂，在治疗BRCA1突变型癌症方面具有显著的治疗潜力。
